text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Trainer-kun. May this year 
be—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, I'll be counting on you even more this 
year. After all, this is the year we 
finally take on the Classic tier.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There is only one grand objective we hold 
this year. Trainer, go ahead and say it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Only by winning this will I earn 
the pedigree fitting to speak of ideals.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
This is going to be an important year for 
us. Let us forge ahead together, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: By the way, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
While the primary goal is set, we probably 
haven't settled on a concrete plan yet." 
his

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"So, I'd like to hear what you think our 
aspirations should be."
choice_data_list:
"Virtuous and Upright" — Always make the 
best choice.

"Complete Health" — taking care of both 
mind and body

"Master of All Martial Arts": Employs a 
wide variety of techniques.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I see, making choices, huh. Indeed, 
situations like that will only increase 
from now on.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, that is something you always 
keep in mind. What is the true intention 
behind making it an ambition at this 
stage?"
choice_data_list:
To make sure you both are on the same 
page.

text_block_list.text:
There will surely be times ahead when she 
and I disagree on things.

He explained that in doing so, he used 
"the best" as a benchmark in the hopes of 
aligning their shared understanding.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Hm, understood.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Then should our opinions clash, let us 
seek the best path together."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Aha, you're taking this chance to 
drive your point home, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She's probably been worried about my 
health for a while now. Hence, "Stay 
Healthy," huh.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have always known the importance of 
maintaining one's health, but I promise to 
be even more mindful of it this year.
choice_data_list:
I'll make sure to keep a close eye on it 
too.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hoh, me? Fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer-kun, let's see what 
you're made of. I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. So you intend to add new weapons on 
top of the fundamentals, is that it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
True, it really is about time we polish up 
your technique alongside building your 
fundamentals.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, speaking of technique, there's 
something I'd love to polish further in 
the future.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Of course it's a pun!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I feel the need to put even more effort 
into this. I've been jotting down notes 
the moment an idea strikes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I have about two of those notepads, would 
you mind taking a look at them?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-kun? Why are you averting your 
gaze?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Why did you take a step back? Hey.

After deciding on our resolutions, the two 
of us were walking through the academy 
grounds when...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Well? Have you changed your mind?

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: However, I...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you believe you haven't accomplished 
anything yet, don't you think it's a bit 
too early to give up?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Therefore, right now—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Attention, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...! President...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to say 'Happy New Year'... but 
the atmosphere isn't particularly 
celebratory, is it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If there's a problem, let me hear it. I'll 
help you out.

text_block_list.name: Student Council General Affairs
text_block_list.text: N-No! There's no problem at all...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...She's right. More importantly, 
President, this is the year you finally 
challenge the Classic Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I imagine you will be busier than ever. 
Please, focus entirely on the training.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...However.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will report on this matter in due 
course. ...Please, grant me your 
understanding.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Understood. Then I shall see you again 
at the New Year's meeting.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. Well then...
After Air Groove and the others left...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I did check in with the general affairs 
girl earlier to see if there were any 
issues, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
She insisted that 'nothing' was wrong. I 
figured it was just hard for her to talk 
to me, so I left it to Air Groove, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Since she's acting like that, it would be 
tactless to pry.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for constantly talking about 
internal student council matters. Even 
though it has nothing to do with races.
choice_data_list:
If it's about you, then it's important to 
me too.

If it concerns you, then it's important to 
me as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, please forget what I just said. I 
need you to focus on strategizing.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
First is how we conquer the Satsuki Sho. 
I'm counting on you, Trainer.
